summary: Frontend-only testing for Tipo de Proyecto auto-inheritance (Part 2) and relational Pinpad sponsorship Procesador→Banco logic in Quote Wizard (Part 3). All flows passed. ProjectDetail correctly shows 'VPOS' (canonical, not merged) for project prj_ac73e960cd14. Quote Wizard's 'Entidad Patrocinadora' (select-sponsor-bank) opens the pinpad-processor-link-modal only when a Procesador is chosen (Consorcio CrediCard), lists 11 linked banks, shows the compound label 'Patrocinador: Consorcio CrediCard — Banco de Venezuela' after selection, and does NOT open the sub-modal for a traditional bank (Banco de Venezuela). Cancel button works.
